state:
Goal `core-math-2-3`: `Core\Math::exp`, `fdiv`, `floor`, `gcd`, `hypot`, `intDiv`, `isFinite`, `isNan`, `lcm`, `log` and `max` carry every feature proof — `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and a `covers:` Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module — and their reference cards are rewritten in the plain voice.
Two members of the goal's `--only` list still owe proofs: `format` and `fromBase`.
The test module's helpers are `float_result` (a float member), `int_pair` (two `int`s, `Ok` or the thrown message), `bool_result` (one `float` in, a `bool` out) and `text_result`; a member with an options block takes each option as one more positional `Value` in the argument slice.
A rewritten card reaches `docs/novis.md` only after `cargo build` and `bun nv reference`; a perf figure goes stale when a member's code moves and is re-recorded with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <ids>`.
`Core\Math::max` and `min` are `T, T`: an `int` beside a `float` does not compile (`E0401`), so a mixed pair reaches the runtime ordering only through two `mixed` variables.
The driver's red `every_workspace_that_builds_our_crates_carries_the_root_patch_table` predates commit `a0910add7` and passes at HEAD.
No proof found a bug in these eleven; `log`'s member doc named a wrong inexact ratio and now names `log(1000.0, {base: 10.0})`.
